notes: The home page footer (repeated on the About pages read) says the site is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International, and its licence link and badge image both point to by-nc/4.0. The badge's alt text alone says plain CC Attribution 4.0 "for any purpose"; the visible statement, link and badge all say NonCommercial, so NonCommercial is recorded and, as Ceder has paid plans, it is link only. Excelsior's privacy and terms page (www.excelsior.edu/PrivacyNoticeTermsOfUse) is on a host that wasn't reachable and wasn't read, so terms on linking or automated use are unknown. Embedded H5P activities and any third-party material may carry their own terms. Revisit if the OWL corrects the alt text or states plain CC BY.
